zapier_model.name: Multi-Dimensional Entity Graph Intersections
zapier_model.formula: PERSON × ROLE × SKILL × LOCATION × EXPERIENCE × SALARY × COMPANY × CAREER PATH × RESUME × JOB
zapier_model.rule: Only expose URLs where real inventory, calculated intelligence, or substantive entity data exists (Zero empty combinations).

wise_model.name: Live Calculated Intelligence Engines
wise_model.principle: The page is valuable because of underlying computation, not 500 words of generic prose.
wise_model.implementation: Real-time salary percentiles (P25, P50, P75, P90), Indian New Tax Regime in-hand take-home calculator, city purchasing power multipliers.

canva_model.name: Interactive Template & Tool Entrances
canva_model.principle: Users search for a tool to solve an immediate problem. Deliver the tool immediately without a login barrier.
canva_model.implementation: Free ATS Resume Score Checker, Role-specific Resume Templates, One-Click Career Roadmap generator.

ugc_viral_model.name: Living Public Career Passport & Shareable Objects
ugc_viral_model.principle: 1M users create 1M living professional entities that they share to LinkedIn, WhatsApp, and recruiters.
ugc_viral_model.implementation: /passport/:slug public verifiable profile with OpenGraph cards, schema markup, and credential verification badges.
